curriculum.name: calls_with
curriculum.goal: Given a person, return all the calls with that person.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
RETURN $v0
END
